root_cause_analysis.no_crash_watchdog_ok: Stability runner reported status=halted with incident type=watchdog_queue_stall (running=false while queue remains non-zero). Swarm exited before draining its event queue. Harness also failed to parse the 'status' field correctly — it looked for 'passed' key which did not exist in the runner output.
root_cause_analysis.integrity_fields_present: Harness called appshak_integrity.run_report with --output-dir flag. Correct flag is --out-root. Module rejected the argument and produced no report files.
root_cause_analysis.decisions_traceable: Governance engine was never started as a background process. Ledger remained at 0 entries because no process was writing to it during the run.
root_cause_analysis.replay_deterministic: Flows from no_crash_watchdog_ok and decisions_traceable failures. No governance data = no replay hash in checkpoints.

fix_summary: Fixed --output-dir to --out-root for integrity report command
Added governance engine bootstrap step before swarm launch
Fixed stability result parser to read 'status' and 'incident' fields correctly
Added automatic stash of previous run before overwriting evidence
Added dead-process check after background services launch
note: Run was killed manually overnight. Evidence captured and stashed for full audit trail per constitutional governance requirements.
